name: Nature Walk Summer Teen Program
what_you_do: Teen volunteers help visitors connect with Como's animals and plants and learn to care about nature. The program also builds work experience and job skills.
who_can_apply: Students going into 8th grade through 12th grade.
pay_detail: Described as a volunteer program; pay is not mentioned on the page.
duration: Mid-June through mid-August, with training days in May and June
deadline_text: The page says applications are no longer being accepted for this summer. Next dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Not listed. The page links to a position description and key dates document. Call 651-487-8201 to ask when applications reopen.
notes: The page says the program needs a big time commitment over the summer. It gives no hours. Other roles on Como's volunteer page are for ages 17 and older.
